user_query: I'm planning a solo trip to explore the world and broaden my knowledge about climate change. Fetch me all the climate change related news and provide me with a list of available regions to consider for my trip. Also, suggest an AI news source to keep me informed.

TaskList.description: Fetch the latest climate change related news articles to stay informed about the topic.
Retrieve a list of regions that are prominent in climate change studies and activities for potential trip destinations.
Suggest an AI-based news source that provides ongoing updates on climate change.
